baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَصَّيْنَا ... بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا is retained on one side of وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ ... فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The connected charge establishes durable beneficence toward the two sources of one's birth, but their effort can press that bond into an unauthorized partnership. The prohibition severs compliance with that command without severing the prior obligation of good conduct.

activation_trace.role: A connected trust passed onward makes filial care a durable charge rather than a passing preference.
The two parents as sources of birth locate the real relational claim that the charge protects.
Beneficent, well-made action defines what remains due in conduct.
Pressing another to the limit supplies the coercive force that tests the relation.
Introducing another into a shared claim identifies the demanded participation as an illegitimate co-claim.
Compliance is the specifically blocked channel, leaving beneficence itself unrevoked.

changed_reading.before: Goodness to parents appears to imply broad filial compliance.
changed_reading.after: The ayah distinguishes an enduring relation of beneficence from a command-specific obedience channel that closes when kinship is used to recruit association.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ is answered by إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The demanded partner has no disclosed mark by which the claim can be recognized, so inherited authority cannot manufacture warrant. Return brings all parties back to the source of judgment, where a consequential report discloses their intentional deeds.

activation_trace.role: Categorical negation removes any present warrant from the proposed object of association.
A distinguishing mark that reveals and guides supplies the missing evidentiary criterion.
Return to the point of origin relocates final adjudication beyond the family command.
The arriving, consequential report makes divine disclosure the answer to unsupported assertion.
Purposive deeds, not inherited claims alone, become the object of the final report.

changed_reading.before: The child should refuse because the parents propose something unknown.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a provenance audit: kinship cannot supply the missing mark of truth, and contested authority is resolved by return and disclosure of each purposive response.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ ... فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا anchors a process in which pressure seeks eventual willing accommodation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Parental striving can operate less as one explicit order than as repeated relational mixing that exhausts resistance. The partnership demand then functions like a snare, while mutual accommodation and the self's easing of an act describe the capture point that the refusal interrupts.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustion through mixing or repeated use supplies a process image for pressure wearing down resistance.
The hunter's snare turns association into a capture mechanism rather than only a proposition.
Mutual accommodation names the relational concession by which pressure could become compliance.
The self's making an act easy marks the internalized endpoint that the prohibition blocks.

changed_reading.before: The parents issue a direct doctrinal command that must be rejected.
changed_reading.after: The ayah can also diagnose a gradual capture process in which intimacy, repetition, and accommodation make unsupported association feel voluntarily easy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context places professed belief in an assay, then makes striving reflexive: its yield returns to the striver's own self while God remains independent. Against that frame, the parents' striving is not evidence of a divine need or a superior claim; it is the local force through which the child's direction of agency is tested.

activation_trace.role: Pressure that carries the child to hardship is the focus-level force under examination.
Testing a person as metal is tested turns declared belief into something whose composition must be exposed.
The repeated assay establishes testing as the opening process rather than an incidental hardship.
Exerting full capacity under difficulty supplies a Godward effort whose benefit loops back to the agent.
The self as the very identity of the person fixes the beneficiary and owner of the striving.
Divine independence removes any inference that God needs the child's resistance.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 place claims of belief under testing before the filial case.
29:6 repeats جهد reflexively and names the self as beneficiary while declaring God independent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, repeated striving, self-benefit, and divine independence; I assign the directional contrast between self-owned Godward effort and parental effort aimed at association. A live alternative is that the repeated root gives only a broad perseverance theme.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a local exception within filial ethics.
changed_reading.after: It is a concentrated assay of professed belief: coercive effort reveals whether the child directs self-owned agency toward an unsupported partner or toward God without imagining that God needs the act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby invitation to follow another path is coupled to an offer to carry the follower's sins; the offer is denied, while misleaders acquire additional burdens without unloading those they misled. The focus return and report therefore make filial obedience morally nontransferable: parents can pressure or mislead, but they cannot absorb the child's enacted association.

activation_trace.role: Common return brings every participant back for judgment without merging their agency.
The final report targets each party's purposive doing rather than the command's family provenance.
Purposive deeds are evaluated and rewarded, establishing action as the operative unit of account.
The best recompense for enacted good sharpens the distinction between conduct and mere affiliation.
Following in another's wake supplies the same delegated-agency structure that filial obedience could enact.
Bearing moral trust or burden frames the false promise that another can take over liability.
Sin as culpable error identifies what the would-be guides promise, but fail, to carry.
Weight that remains weight makes the leaders' added burdens cumulative rather than substitutive.

structural_cues: 29:12 says, in effect, follow our path and we will carry your sins, then immediately denies the transfer.
29:13 assigns misleaders their own loads plus added loads, not the removal of the followers' loads.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a structurally parallel command to follow and an explicit failed liability transfer; I map that speech-act pattern onto the parents' demand. The alternative is that 29:12 concerns public ideological leaders only, though the agency rule still bears on the focus.

changed_reading.before: Refusal protects the child from accepting a false proposition.
changed_reading.after: Refusal also blocks a false delegation of moral agency: neither affection nor obedience lets the originators of the command carry away the child's liability for acting on it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, objects taken besides God become a bond of worldly affection between people, but that bond reverses into mutual repudiation; Abraham then moves from one abode toward his Lord. This sharpens the focus distinction: filial affection and beneficence remain real goods, yet they must not become the connective material that stabilizes association, and directional separation need not mean hatred of kin.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another preserves a real ethical connection even when obedience is interrupted.
Beneficence keeps the surviving relation positively defined rather than merely tolerated.
A shared claim marks the point where relational connection becomes impermissible participation.
Love and affection supply the social adhesive by which false objects bind a group.
The connection standing between parties makes that affection an actual social structure.
Movement from one abode to another provides a non-hostile directional break toward the Lord.

structural_cues: 29:25 makes worldly affection around false objects end in mutual rejection and cursing at resurrection.
29:26 turns immediately to Abraham's migration toward his Lord, while 29:27 restores descendants and inherited gifts rather than erasing lineage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies affection as social glue, its eschatological reversal, migration, and renewed descendants; I infer that the focus regulates family affection before it hardens into cultic solidarity. The live alternative is that 29:25 describes civic idol-bonds rather than kinship specifically.

changed_reading.before: Kindness and doctrinal refusal are adjacent but independent duties.
changed_reading.after: Kindness preserves affection while refusal prevents affection itself from becoming the glue of association; even separation can be directional fidelity rather than repudiation of kin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah shows decorated deeds blocking a path even while their agents possess apparent insight, then pictures protectors besides God as a shelter whose structure is weakest. The focus's lack of knowledge therefore reaches beyond missing information: the felt security of a parent, household, or guardian cannot serve as proof when that protective office is converted into associational authority.

activation_trace.role: Parents as the sources of birth supply the focus's closest natural protective authority.
Assigning a partner to God identifies the point at which protection is promoted into rival authority.
Actual disclosure to the knower, rather than social confidence, is the required warrant.
Making a thing appear good explains how misdirected deeds can feel evidentially persuasive.
Purposive deeds are the material that appearance beautifies and redirects.
Turning away and diverting converts persuasive appearance into path-blocking force.
Heart-insight remaining compatible with misdirection warns that felt discernment is not sufficient proof.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the protective office wrongly installed besides God.
Shelter and dwelling materialize the promise of safety made by such an authority.
Loss of strength exposes the protective structure's failure under load.
True knowing is what would disclose the weakness hidden by the shelter image.

structural_cues: 29:38 joins beautified deeds, obstruction of the path, and agents described as discerning.
29:41 joins protectors besides God, a house, structural weakness, and the counterfactual of knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies misleading appearance, apparent insight, protective office, shelter, weakness, and knowledge; I infer a household-authority analogy because the focus names parents. The analogy is not an identification of parents with the spider house and should remain qualified.

changed_reading.before: Parents can assert an unwarranted religious proposition despite their legitimate status.
changed_reading.after: The ayah also refuses to treat legitimate closeness and protection as self-authenticating evidence: a household authority becomes structurally weak when made a partner-authority beside God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later instruction preserves the best mode while affirming one God and yielding to Him, and the closing reprise gives striving a different direction: effort in God is met by gentle guidance into paths and culminates in the doers of good. The focus refusal is thus disciplined noncompliance, not reciprocal coercion: it withholds submission from the parents' aim while continuing حسن.

activation_trace.role: Beneficent action supplies the continuing manner of response.
Coercive pressure that carries another to hardship defines the manner not to reciprocate.
The bounded refusal targets submission to the demand rather than every form of relation.
Doing what is best gives the refusal a constructive interpersonal mode.
Divine oneness without partner states the nonnegotiable content protected by the boundary.
Handing over and yielding fixes submission on God rather than on the coercive human command.
Full exertion under difficulty reverses the direction of striving from recruitment into association to fidelity in God.
Gentle indication toward the true path contrasts guidance with the parents' coercive pressure.
The doers of beneficence close the surah by reconnecting resistance to حسن.

structural_cues: 29:46 coordinates the best manner, divine oneness, and surrender to God.
29:69 answers striving with guidance into multiple paths and closes on المحسنين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated حسن, one God, surrender, striving, gentle guidance, and the closing muhsinin; I infer a sustained ethic of kind noncompliance. The alternative is that 29:46 governs a different interlocutor class, but 29:69 still reconnects the focus roots directly.

changed_reading.before: Do not obey is primarily a negative exception to a positive filial rule.
changed_reading.after: Do not obey is a positive discipline: resist the coercive vector, keep the best mode of conduct, yield only to the One, and let difficult striving be answered by guidance rather than counter-pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Migration toward the Lord, the widening of God's earth, and every self's return make the focus's return clause a larger spatial and temporal home. Filial goodness can remain connected across distance, while obedience and residence are allowed to separate when the local household becomes coercive.

activation_trace.role: Connection between things lets the ethical bond persist without requiring shared location or direction.
The birth relation remains the bond carried through any relocation.
Return to the ultimate point of origin provides the focus's larger destination.
Departure from one abode to another toward the Lord supplies a faithful spatial separation.
Expansive space contrary to constriction makes coercive locality nonfinal.
Each self as the person in identity individualizes the journey and its accountability.
Universal return repeats the focus destination after the command to inhabit God's wide earth.

structural_cues: 29:26 names movement toward the Lord after a social rupture.
29:56-57 place wide earth, individual mortality, and return to God in immediate sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies migration, spatial width, individual selfhood, and return; I infer that these make the filial obligation portable when pressure requires distance. The alternative is that the migration frame concerns public persecution rather than a household conflict.

changed_reading.before: To Me is your return functions mainly as a future warning after the family dispute.
changed_reading.after: Return also supplies a larger home from which present coercive locality can be left: distance may interrupt obedience or residence without cancelling filial beneficence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ط و ع to س ط ع mapping and a material house analogy, not the ordinary sense of obedience. It remains anchored in فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا and is cross-checked by the weak-house image in 29:41; downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant structural analogy, never as the lexical meaning of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping for تُطِعْ supplies an erected house-pole image at the exact point where compliance is withheld.

activation_trace.role: An erected tent-pole gives withheld compliance the material role of support not supplied to a false structure.
Association identifies the structure whose rival claim must not be propped up.
Shelter and dwelling provide the context structure that would require support.
Weakness under load explains why the associational shelter cannot truly stand.

changed_reading.before: The child simply declines to comply with the parents' command.
changed_reading.after: Materially, the refusal can be pictured as withholding the supporting pole by which a sheltering but associational household claim would appear able to stand.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus never calls parents a shore and 29:65 describes a broader crisis-to-safety reversal. It remains anchored in the focus's parents, obedience, and association and in the context's explicit movement from exclusive devotion at sea to renewed association on land; render it as an analogy about ordinary safety reactivating compromise, not as an identification of family with unbelief.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The parents are the ayah's nearest relation of origin and safety, yet their pressure aims at تُشْرِكَ and tests whether exclusive orientation survives ordinary closeness.

activation_trace.role: Parents as sources of birth supply the ordinary relation of origin and safety in the analogy.
Association with God names the compromise demanded within that safe relation.
Exclusive separation from association supplies the clarity produced under danger.
Obedient yielding locates crisis devotion wholly with God.
Dry land supplies the restored zone of ordinary safety where exclusive orientation is tested again.
Renewed association after rescue supplies the reversal that the focus boundary guards against.

changed_reading.before: Parental pressure is an isolated doctrinal conflict inside the family.
changed_reading.after: It may also be read as a shore test: the return to familiar relational safety is precisely where crisis-clear exclusivity can soften back into association.

strongest_changes: The opening assay and reflexive striving turn the family conflict into a test of self-owned direction rather than a contest between divine and parental needs.
The follow-and-carry-burdens sequence makes obedience nontransferable moral agency: parents may mislead but cannot remove the child's liability.
Affection, household protection, migration, and wide earth distinguish preserving kinship from installing kinship as rival authority.
The closing pairing of striving, gentle guidance, and muhsinin recovers حسن as the manner of resistance, making the command disciplined kind noncompliance.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly separated closeness, affection, shelter, and guidance from coercive following. It changed a filial exception into a portable ethics of beneficence with bounded obedience, evidentiary discipline, and nontransferable accountability.
remaining_uncertainties: The household, spider-house, and shore correspondences are reader-supplied analogies rather than explicit identifications.
The marker branch of ع ل م sharpens the epistemic model, but ordinary knowledge may carry most of the clause's force.
The ط و ع to س ط ع house-pole activation is licensed by the packet's split mapping but remains deliberately form-distant.
